title: Desk bridge v0: settings
description: Settings the person can see and change, kept per caller like the store: every key belongs to the caller that set it. A caller reads and writes its own keys without a scope; reading other callers' keys needs settings:read.

SettingKey.description: A key in its owner's namespace, lowercase and dotted: voice, motion.reduce.

MigratedFrom.description: The earlier full name (owner.key, from the setting's renamed list) the value in force was read under, because no layer held one under the setting's own name.

SettingsGetRequest.description: Read one setting: the caller's own, or another caller's under settings:read.

SettingsGetParams.description: Parameters of settings.get. owner defaults to the caller; another owner needs a scope that covers owner/key.

SettingsGetResult.description: Result of settings.get. value is absent when the key was never set.

SettingsSetRequest.description: Write one of the caller's own settings (64 KiB of JSON at most). A value that fails the setting's declaration (kind, choices, minimum, maximum, pattern) is refused with invalid_value.

SettingsListRequest.description: List settings: the caller's own, or every setting a settings:read scope covers.

SettingsListParams.description: Parameters of settings.list. Without scope, the caller's own settings; with one, every setting it covers, whoever owns it.

SettingsListResult.description: Result of settings.list, by owner and then key.

InvalidSetting.description: A value a layer holds for a setting that fails its declaration, so the layer below is in force instead (for init.yaml, the default). file and line say where the value is written: init.yaml, a profile file or a plugin.json; a value set through settings.set has neither.

value.description: The value that failed. Any JSON value.

reason.description: What it fails, for people: "purple" is not one of system, light, dark.

line.description: The line of the setting's name in file, from 1.

SettingsInvalidEvent.description: A setting's value fell back. Sent to the setting's owner and to desk (the runtime, which tells the person) when the core first meets the value, and to desk again for every one still in force each time desk calls init.get.

SettingsChangedEvent.description: A setting changed. Sent to its owner, and to callers subscribed to settings.changed whose settings:read grant covers it.
